svg.title: Replanning loop
svg.desc: A loop of six boxes. Top row, left to right: run the tree (red), tag 1 detect a trigger, tag 2 stop at a safe point. An arrow goes down to the bottom row, which runs right to left: tag 3 write a new problem from the blackboard, tag 4 plan, build the tree, swap it in, tag 5 count replans. An arrow goes from count replans back up to run the tree. A second arrow from count replans leads down to a dashed box: no plan, or past the limit: stop and report.

path.aria-label: no plan, or past the limit: stop and report
